selection: Execute RC75's explicitly unexecuted continuous common-bias model; distinguish target classification from complete state recovery.
actualWork: Derived and hand-proved the exact continuous bounded-model minimax radius using matching zero-observation worlds and LP duality.
Extended the radius to indexed arbitrary substitutions and erasures using maximum retained-subset ambiguity and a nonlinear feasible-set midpoint.
Constructed a zero-margin threshold impossibility witness and a one-error collision for four balanced sensors.
Executed exact rational primal/dual checks on 1152 general-coefficient cases and stored fixture certificates and collision histories.
Executed observation-specific feasible sets with and without an outlier; both selected joint-model fixtures gave [1/10,3/10]. Marginal-only relaxation gave [-3/5,1].
Derived and tested minimal six/eight-sensor constructions within the explicitly restricted plus/minus unit-response family.
A separate Python Fraction implementation checked 4320 parameter/fault combinations and 34452 subset evaluations with 27 cached polygons and no mismatches.

achievementClasses.proof: Complete handwritten model-conditional minimax and margin arguments; internal same-model adversarial review, not external or proof-assistant validation.
achievementClasses.counterexamples: Uniform zero-margin classification fails when radius is positive. Fixed linear estimators fail under arbitrary replacement. Four balanced sensors lose the small radius under one replacement.
achievementClasses.construction: Nonlinear feasible-set decoder; exact conditional sensor-count optimum only in the identical-bound +/-1 response family.
achievementClasses.calculation: Exact rational arithmetic, no floating tolerance or statistical extrapolation. Finite checks do not supply the general theorem.
achievementClasses.novelty: Application of established set-membership estimation, LP duality and error/erasure reasoning. No new foundational theorem claim.
achievementClasses.originalProblem: Unrestricted finite-measurement verification and arbitrary distribution-shift coverage remain unsolved.

failures.route: Cancel common bias and infer exact classification at every threshold-adjacent state
failures.rejection: Opposite states +/-1/20 with admissible opposite residual errors give identical zero readings.

failures.route: Use one fixed average under arbitrary replacements
failures.rejection: Replacing a nonzero-weight reading by an unbounded value gives unbounded error; use the nonlinear feasible set instead.

failures.route: Preserve one-error robustness with only two sensors of each bias sign
failures.rejection: A retained common-healthy pair can have one sign, permitting radius 11/10; three of each sign are necessary in the restricted family.

implementationBoundary: Observation decoder stops on alpha_K=0 branches rather than classify infeasible/unbounded LPs; current observation fixtures all have alpha_i=1. Radius solver explicitly reports such radii as unbounded.
unresolvedDependencies: Physical validity of known coefficient and disturbance bounds
Coverage of unobserved support after environmental shift
Unknown or drifting nuisance response coefficients
nextExecutableTarget: Set beta_i=betaBar_i+u_i, |u_i|<=rho_i. Construct cross-threshold feasible worlds retaining common b and compare the exact feasible set with the eta_i+B*rho_i outer approximation. Do not assert empirical validity of rho or B.
safety: Offline synthetic measurement mathematics only; no personal data, physical intervention, paid resources or cyber operations.
